metadata.input_from: Growth Marketer (15) audit output and repository documentation

funnel_findings.finding: Discoverability trust cues are present, but visitor/clone baseline is unavailable.
Setup start event is not instrumented as a conversion event.
Setup completion is operationally observable but not conversion-tracked.
No explicit event proves first cycle completion in telemetry.
A/B experimentation is not statistically ready due to missing baselines and sizing inputs.

risks.title: Funnel Not Quantified
risks.description: Conversion funnel is defined procedurally but not numerically.
mitigations: Implement minimum conversion schema: repo_view, setup_start, setup_success, first_command_queued, first_cycle_completed

risks.title: Setup Dependency Drop-Off
risks.description: Setup requires multiple prerequisites and has known startup/connectivity failure modes.
mitigations: Add a fast-path onboarding flow with fallback troubleshooting branch

risks.title: Telemetry Quality Blocks Experiments
risks.description: Client/server allowlist mismatch rejects onboarding events, reducing metric reliability.
mitigations: Resolve analytics allowlist mismatch and verify >= 99% valid event acceptance

risks.title: Brand Naming Cognitive Friction
risks.description: Inconsistent product naming increases cognitive load for new users.
mitigations: Standardize one canonical product name across top-level surfaces

recommendations.recommendation: Implement minimum conversion event schema with five persisted and queryable funnel events.
Resolve client/server analytics allowlist mismatch and validate event acceptance rate >= 99% for valid funnel events.
Add a 3-step fast-path onboarding section and explicit fallback path in README and User Manual.
Standardize canonical product naming across README, UI title, and docs metadata.
Define first A/B backlog with baseline, MDE, alpha, power, and duration after telemetry baseline exists.

questionnaire_requests.question_context: Confirm canonical first successful cycle definition.
Confirm if GitHub traffic sources can be official acquisition baseline for Phase 4 KPI tracking.
